events.info: J-L Cauvin is a veteran stand-up comedian who became an Internet sensation with over 40 million views of his political impersonations and sketch videos. He has been seen and heard on The Late Late Show, Howard Stern, Marc Maron's WTF podcast, The Adam Carolla Show and ESPN radio. He has 8 stand-up albums to his credit, 2 weekly podcasts (Making Podcasts Great Again and Rain on Your Parade) and recently made his acting debut on Showtime's Billions. In 2023 J-L released his first stand up special, TALL BOY, and then in April 2024, his second special, HALF-BLACKFACE, began streaming on Amazon Prime. Check out more at JLCauvin.com!

venues.parkingDetail: Parking is available on the surrounding grounds at Highmark Mann. General Parking is $25 in advance and $30 day-of-show. Parking upgrades are also available. Your parking fee helps support our non-profit mission.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: For general admission shows, putchase tickets and accommodation made at door. Accessible seats are also sold through the Ticket Office.

generalInfo.generalRule: Whether you prefer a beautiful buffet dinner with seasonal fare, a picnic on the Russ and Wendy Palmer Great Lawn, or delicious, freshly-prepared casual food and drink on your way to your seat, the Highmark Mann offers a variety of dining and drink options. Most importantly, every option comes complete with a spectacular view of the Philadelphia skyline, not to mention the sun, the moon, and the stars! http://manncenter.org/dining Picnics are welcome on select designated Summer Picnic nights featuring The Philadelphia Orchestra. If you're planning on picnicking on the lawn pre-concert and moving to your reserved seat under cover when the performance begins, please be sure that your cooler is small enough to be stowed under your seat. No glass containers are allowed under cover. Kegs and mini kegs are not permitted into the theater. No outside food or beverage will be allowed into concerts with popular artists. Restrictions are indicated at the bottom of all event pages. One 20-oz bottle of water per person is permitted for all concerts. Outside lawn chairs are not allowed for any performance except the select concerts included in the Highmark Mann's Summer Picnic Series. Lawn chair rentals will be available for all concerts at our TD Pavilion. Lawn chairs are not permitted at any concerts at our general admission Highmark Skyline Stage. Blankets are permitted for all performances. Small personal cameras and camera phones are allowed in the Highmark Mann unless prohibited by the performing artist. Advance notice of camera policy change will be posted prior to the patron entering the gate and included in pre-concert emails (when possible). Flash photography, professional camera or recording equipment (including cameras with detachable lenses, any form of camera stand or audio/video recording devices), and iPads/tablets for the purpose of photography are prohibited. Photography of any kind is prohibited during orchestra performances. Patrons found possessing professional equipment not expressly authorized will be asked to check their cameras at Visitors' Services or will be escorted off campus. Dogs and other service animals are welcome, but no pets, please. Strollers are strongly discouraged at all events. The Mann does not have designated parking areas for strollers.
